description: Open-source credit-ledger and billing SDK for AI SaaS applications, with synchronized Python and JavaScript clients.
rules: Use the bursar package for Python and @zonastery/bursar for JavaScript or TypeScript.
Run the Bursar database migrations before using a PostgreSQL-backed store.
Use the same versioned configuration document with both SDKs; the Python and JavaScript clients share the canonical PostgreSQL schema and behavioral contracts.
Treat PostgreSQL as authoritative; S3 and ClickHouse are optional analytics delivery backends.
